leftEvidence.title: Joseph’s tomb is sealed and guarded

points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: Joseph receives the body, wraps and places it in his new tomb, women remain opposite it, and the leaders obtain a guard and seal the stone.
points.right: Joseph, who had not consented to the decision, asks for the body and lays it in a new tomb; women observe and prepare spices before resting.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
points.right: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.

payload.posture: Matthew and Luke preserve distinct closures to the burial sequence.

rightEvidence.title: A council member acts while the Sabbath approaches

payload.tension: Matthew continues to sealing and a guard on the next day; Luke closes with women preparing spices and resting according to the commandment.
payload.title: Guarded tomb / Sabbath rest
